title: Nonzero-charge two-matter/two-holonomy joint-cylinder compatibility on the stable strip

parents.composition_rule: This is a separately versioned researcher-owned extension. It does not edit, supersede or retroactively complete PAH-001 or any predecessor contract.

exact_scope.carrier_family: The PAH-OMC-004 two-row strip G_n. G_2 contains the first two split squares and G_3 adds only the next frontier split square; the four-vertex patch, its five links and both split triangular faces are retained unchanged.
exact_scope.anchors: a=(0,0) and d=(1,1) are the two retained matter anchors. The audited anchor-preserving automorphism group is the identity.
exact_scope.comparison: The exact finite comparison is the neutral coordinate inclusion J_(2,3): G_2 -> G_3. Level 1 is retained only as the inherited G_1 -> G_2 matter-transfer boundary control.
exact_scope.state_domain: Finite states have one radial occupation quantum at exactly one of a,b,c,d, zero radial occupation on remote vertices, four Z_2 phases, five Z_2 patch links and four aperture bits. The nonzero charge is Q=1.
exact_scope.functional: Evaluate exactly the displayed PAH-001 F_rho: aperture onsite and matter polynomial, aperture edge stiffness, covariant matter edge term and plaquette Wilson term. No term, counterterm, coupling or rate is added.
exact_scope.joint_observable: The cylinder basis is every bounded function of (ell_a,ell_d,H_0,H_1). H_0 is the Z_2 character of the first split triangle h00 v1 d0^{-1}; H_1 is the Z_2 character of the second split triangle d0 h01^{-1} v0^{-1}. Both matter coordinates are gauge neutral.
exact_scope.moves: Use unchanged PAH directed roots. Radial-transfer roots on every carrier edge incident to a or d are retained, including the frontier h11 edge incident to d. Link roots on all five patch links h00,v0,d0,h01,v1 retain both sigma=+1 and sigma=-1 channels. A radial root changes only matter coordinates; a retained link root changes H_0 and/or H_1.
exact_scope.normalization: Finite counting-measure Gibbs midpoint rates exactly as in PAH-001; no averaging over dropped variables is used. Mobility is the unchanged endpoint product and the exact exponent is -beta DeltaF/2.
exact_scope.limit: No cutoff, volume, lattice, continuum, phase, beta or observation limit is taken. n is only a finite refinement label.

maps.geometric_inclusion: J_(2,3) retains every G_2 vertex, edge, aperture, phase, radial occupation and link coordinate by geometric ID; new G_3 coordinates are appended with neutral aperture, zero radial occupation and neutral Z_2 labels. Since the old state has Q=1, J preserves Q.
maps.local_restriction: The joint interaction closure is the union of matter closures incident to a or d and both closed triangular face closures. It contains the four patch vertices, five patch links and two split faces, and is identical in G_2 and G_3. The radial degree sum in the fixture is 11 per one-hot placement block, yielding 90112 retained radial rows.
maps.observable_lift: I_(2,3)f is the same pointwise coordinate cylinder f(ell_a,ell_d,H_0,H_1) on both finite state spaces; it is not a conditional expectation and is defined on every fine state.
maps.root_correspondence: Each retained radial or patch-link root has the same admissibility, exact energy increment, endpoint mobility, midpoint exponent and four-coordinate observable increment in G_2 and G_3. Five links times two K=2 channels yield 327680 link rows; the total retained root count is 417792.

gauge_and_anchor_invariance.gauge_action: g in Z_2^V shifts phase n_v by g_v and carried link exponent u_(v,w) by g_w-g_v; ell and aperture are fixed.
gauge_and_anchor_invariance.closed_face_cancellation: For H_0 the incidence is (g_b-g_a)+(g_d-g_b)-(g_d-g_a)=0. For H_1 it is (g_d-g_a)-(g_d-g_c)-(g_c-g_a)=0. Thus both closed-face characters are gauge invariant. A pure link coordinate remains non-invariant.
gauge_and_anchor_invariance.anchor_action: Only the identity automorphism is used, so the four-coordinate cylinder is anchor preserving. No nontrivial symmetry average is inserted.

compatibility_proposition.statement: For every audited Q=1 patch state, the complete retained root list for (ell_a,ell_d,H_0,H_1) is identical under J_(2,3): all radial roots incident to a or d and both sigma channels on each of the five patch links have identical exact tuples (state, family, cell, direction, DeltaF, mobility^2, four observable increments, midpoint exponent). All other PAH roots have zero increment on every bounded function of the joint coordinates.
proof_obligations: The radial energy difference is the exact sum of changed endpoint onsite and incident covariant terms; the union support, including the d-frontier h11 edge, is unchanged between G_2 and G_3.
A patch-link root changes only its covariant edge term and Wilson face terms containing that edge; both split-triangle incidences are unchanged between G_2 and G_3.
The two independent incidence cancellations prove H_0 and H_1 gauge invariance, while ell_a and ell_d are neutral and the anchor automorphism group is the identity.
The neutral inclusion preserves Q=1, every retained patch coordinate and every retained directed root channel, including both K=2 link labels.
The G_1 -> G_2 matter-transfer control retains the known nonzero boundary defect and is not included in the stable proposition.
compatibility_proposition.cumulative_consequence: The finite four-coordinate joint cylinder has zero geometric generator defect for the G_2 -> G_3 comparison. No supremum over all cylinders, volumes, regulators, phases or limit parameters is asserted.

finite_acceptance.primary: Enumerate all 32768 fixture states and every retained radial/link root, evaluate exact local differences of the full displayed PAH energy, cross-check local formulas against complete energy on bounded samples and compare rootwise digests between G_2 and G_3.
finite_acceptance.independent: Rebuild the carrier, both gauge-invariant holonomies, matter values, all PAH energy terms, local root differences and midpoint rows from direct formulas without importing the primary implementation.
finite_acceptance.hostile: Reject a pure link or open-face cylinder, omission of either Wilson face or covariant term, reduction to one matter/one face, collapsed K=2 channels, premature G_1 -> G_2 extension, fitted rates, conditional averaging and physical promotion.
finite_acceptance.lean: Cross-check charge, both closed-face cancellations, state count, K=2 channel multiplicity, two matter coordinates, root identity, boundary defect and the non-promotion firewall. Lean is a finite algebraic cross-check, not a global theorem formalization.

known_boundaries.boundary_control: The G_1 -> G_2 h00 matter-transfer control remains Delta F 0 versus -1; the first split boundary is not promoted.
known_boundaries.local_only: The proposition covers one four-coordinate Q=1 finite strip fixture. It does not cover arbitrary matter, link, plaquette or radial cylinders, or a global common algebra.
known_boundaries.fixture_only: Q=1, K=2, M_s=M_psi=1 and unit displayed couplings are a finite researcher fixture. No parameter-uniform theorem is claimed.
known_boundaries.no_global_uniformity: Exact rootwise equality at G_2 -> G_3 does not establish a regulator-, volume- or source-uniform interaction estimate, an infinite-volume generator or an ordered limit.
known_boundaries.no_physics: The Markov time and Q=1 sector are not quantum time, a physical sector, a vacuum, Pre-A, spacetime, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, a continuum or a mass gap.
